findings.title: Mass General Brigham to pause Home Hospital service at three campuses and reduce program capacity
findings.exact_supporting_passage: its clinical operations will be indefinitely paused
findings.access_consequences: Mass General Brigham confirmed November 2026 service changes: indefinitely pause Home Hospital clinical operations at Salem Hospital (Salem), Newton-Wellesley Hospital (Newton), and Brigham and Women's Faulkner Hospital (Boston); retain service focused on Massachusetts General Hospital and Brigham and Women's Hospital with eventual capacity no more than 30 concurrent patients, down from a reported 70 in August 2024. The exact implementation day and patient-transfer effects are unknown. This is a confirmed announced service change, not evidence of an already completed suspension.
findings.affected_population: Patients who would otherwise qualify for acute hospital-level care at home through the affected Massachusetts hospitals; number of directly affected patients unknown.

findings.title: Mass Eye and Ear to stop general pediatric inpatient admissions to its 10th-floor unit by January 1
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Mass Eye and Ear will end general pediatric inpatient admissions
findings.access_consequences: Mass Eye and Ear's general pediatric inpatient admissions to its 10th-floor unit will end by January 1, 2027. The health system plans to redirect general pediatric inpatients to Newton-Wellesley Hospital, Wentworth-Douglass Hospital, Massachusetts General Hospital, and other Mass General Brigham for Children locations. This is a defined inpatient-service discontinuation with alternate destinations; exact last admission date and realized impacts remain unverified.
findings.affected_population: Children requiring general inpatient pediatric care at Mass Eye and Ear; caseload unknown.
